items.title: Eight brokers cut Kering price targets ahead of Q3 earnings
items.summary: German financial wire reports that CIC, Barclays, Oddo BHF, JP Morgan, Jefferies, Morgan Stanley, HSBC and Citi all cut their Kering price targets in the first week of October, citing continued Gucci softness. The piece cites first-half group net income down 60% and Gucci comparable revenue down 5%, with Kering stock trading nearly 40% below its 52-week high.

items.title: RBC: Gucci to drag on Kering's Q3 results, cuts target to EUR 260
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets forecasts Gucci organic sales falling 5% in Q3 2026, pulling Kering's fashion and leather goods division down about 2% overall ahead of the Oct. 22 earnings release. RBC's 2026 earnings estimate sits 8% below consensus and the note argues the market is pricing in recovery too early.

items.title: Kering CEO Luca de Meo on re-engineering the group around creativity
items.summary: In a WWD interview, Kering CEO Luca de Meo said 'the studio is the soul of a luxury house' and reiterated that Gucci has 'lost some of its shine,' with a goal of doubling leather goods' share of Gucci revenue to 20% by 2030. De Meo also said further price increases are not viable and the house must compete on quality and the right price point.

items.title: Gucci's China-made sneakers reopen the 'Made in Italy' debate
items.summary: Italian daily Il Foglio criticizes Gucci for manufacturing its EUR 800 'Drip' slip-on sneakers in China rather than Italy, arguing the brand's technical-expertise justification exposes a deeper gap in Italian industrial policy. The piece frames European consumers paying luxury prices for Chinese-made goods as a reputational and political problem for Italian manufacturing.

items.title: Milan Fashion Week SS27 wrap-up: Gucci's 'store as runway' strategy
items.summary: Updated round-up of Milan Fashion Week SS27 highlights how Demna rebuilt a boutique inside the former Fiera Campionaria for Gucci's second collection, read by local press as a deliberate signal that commercial execution (foot traffic, retail productivity) is now prioritized over spectacle alone.

items.title: Milan Fashion Week SS27 generated 5.1 million brand mentions; Gucci second on both news and social
items.summary: Media-intelligence firm Onclusive's data shows Gucci took 15.3% of social share of voice (second to Moschino's 29.3%) and 8.8% of digital news share (second to Prada's 12.5%) among 60 brands tracked during Milan Fashion Week. The hashtag #GucciTheStoreShow alone generated 587,918 mentions, with Jannik Sinner's front-row appearance adding news prominence.

items.title: Cardi B's theatrical entrance at Gucci's 'The Store Show' in Milan
items.summary: Cardi B arrived at Demna's Gucci 'Store Show' presentation in Milan in an oversized fur coat, an entrance fans online compared to a 'mafia boss' arrival. The appearance anchored celebrity-driven coverage of Demna's first fully personal Gucci collection.

items.title: X post: Cardi B's Milan Fashion Week appearance led celebrity digital-news coverage share
items.summary: A fashion-data tracking account posted that Cardi B's Milan Fashion Week SS27 appearances (including the Gucci show) were the week's most-covered celebrity moment in digital news at 8.2% of coverage, ahead of Jennifer Lopez and Jannik Sinner.
